reviewed: 2026-10-23 (Antigravity 1.4.6 stdout entry; admission states); 2026-10-21 (ACCEPT-1; narrowed to exact tested version/route combinations in the ACCEPT-1 follow-up, Owner disposition 4); 2026-10-23 (selection before normalization: version bootstrap, retain-only pending records, contradictory assertions)
selection_rule: exactly one entry whose cli, profile and route match and whose inclusive [min_version, max_version] contains the CLI version selects the source description, contract and mapper; overlapping entries are a configuration error rejected at load; no match retains the acquired input under the untested-compatibility contract and flags it, never the numerically nearest entry; a version inside the range that is not listed under tested is reported in_range (reviewed range, not individually tested; no bundled entry currently has such a range: every entry is one exactly tested version on its tested route, and 2.1.300 to 2.1.302, 2.1.299 or 2.1.303 on stdout and 2.1.304 on sdk match no entry); a version not yet known is reported version_unknown, and every record that arrives meanwhile is retained whole and unnormalized; vendor normalization of a record requires a selected entry (tested or in_range): the version bootstrap below reads only the version and its location, selects, and then the record that carried the version is normalized under that selection; contradictory version assertions within one capture (the launch declaration and the stream, or two records) are status conflict: every assertion is kept with its origin, and normalization stops for the rest of the capture

routes.stdout: the CLI's raw standard output read by the capture process (no SDK stage)
routes.sdk: stream lines delivered by a vendor SDK (claude-code-sdk rawJson); a filtered surface
routes.native_session_file: the file the CLI wrote on its own account, read after the run
routes.otel_file: the file the CLI's own OpenTelemetry file exporter wrote during the run
routes.usage_report_file: the report the CLI wrote at exit to a file the launch named
routes.stderr: the CLI's standard error read by the capture process

admission.meaning: the evidence state of each entry, apart from whether it selects a contract: admitted (a production stream route whose live captures, sanitized replay fixtures, inventories, dispositions, independent profile, mapping catalog route and column and live-scenario roster are all registered; MappingCatalogTest rejects an admitted entry that lacks one), experimental (a source route tested on recorded evidence, used as a declared source of a reviewed final-assembly profile or kept for its recordings; not admitted: it lacks a field-disposition catalog, an independent oracle profile or live-scenario registration), historical (a retired route kept so its labelled recordings replay as tested; never extended)

version_bootstrap.meaning: the only vendor facts read before a compatibility entry is selected: which record reports the CLI version (record members that must equal the given strings) and the RFC 6901 location of the version in it; nothing else in that record or any other is interpreted until a selection allows it. A profile without a rule never learns its version from its records: the capture declares it at launch, or it stays unknown

claude_stream.basis: the stream-json init record reports the running CLI's version

codex_rollout.basis: the rollout's session_meta record reports the version of the CLI that wrote the file

copilot_events.basis: the session file's session.start reports the version of the CLI that started the session; standard output reports none (the capture declares the version it discovered)

copilot_otel.basis: every span's resource states the exporting CLI's version as service.version
